title: 第734章 告状禁足第733章 以身对玄兵
lines: 许溟死了。
死在陆沉的拳头下，也是死在他自己的狂妄里。
陆沉站在许溟身死的地方，沉默等待。
死气正在从许溟的体内逸散。
阴阳境宗师的死亡与寻常人不同。
他们体内炼化的那两道天地本源会在身死之后崩解，化作最原始的天地之力回归天地。
而在那崩解的过程中，会释放出极为浓郁的死气。
那些死气不是怨念，不是煞气，而是天地本源从“生”转入“死”那一瞬间产生的纯粹的死亡之力。
陆沉的生死轮转在这一刻自行运转，像一头嗅到血腥味的猛兽，贪婪地吞噬着那些逸散的死气。
死气涌入他的体内，与他灵台中那枚丹丸上的死之真意交汇融合。
他能感觉到体内的生死平衡在发生变化。
生之真意在死气的滋养下被牵引着一同壮大，甚至是以一种螺旋上升的方式。
生死互根，阴阳互生。
死气越是浓烈，生机越是蓬勃。
生机越是蓬勃，死气越是深沉！
阴阳境中期的瓶颈在这一刻松动了。
这股从死亡中孕育出的生机为他逐渐撑开了这条晋升的路。
按照这样的速度，兴许再杀几个宗师，他就能将阴阳境推到大成，此后逐渐甚至触碰到法相的门槛！
这个念头像一株有毒的藤蔓，悄无声息地从心底最深处攀爬上来。
缠绕着他的灵台，试图扎根生长。
陆沉猛然惊觉，身上出了一层细密的冷汗。
他稳住心神，将那株刚刚冒头的念头连根拔起，碾碎在掌中。
这种想法完全超脱了他先前给定下的持戒的范畴。
杀心渐长！
只为了自己的实力，就要让自己脱离掌控，这种事情他不可能去做。
他深吸一口气，将目光从许溟的尸体上移开，望向远处那片被初冬的薄雾笼罩的群山。
杀该杀之人，取该取之物。
他的路，不该是单纯的尸山血海铺就的！
陆沉将心神沉入丹田，看向那枚悬浮在灵台上方的游神道果。
道果上的光芒微微闪烁，像一盏被点亮的灯。
他仔细感应，发现道果仪式的进度已经发生了变化。
镇杀成道大妖十八只，完成其一。
许溟是人类宗师，可在游神道果的判定中，宗师级别的人类修士，也算“大妖”。
这个发现让陆沉有些惊喜。
他先前以为，想要完成这道果的仪式，得去猎杀那些真正的妖兽才有可能。
可这天下的妖兽本就不多，灵潮未复，妖兽想成宗师更是难上加难。
他已经做好了等到灵潮真正降临时再去完成这个仪式的打算，甚至做好了这辈子都完不成的准备。
没想到柳暗花明！
content_en:
Xu Ming is dead.
He who died under Lu Chen's fist also died from his own arrogance.
Lu Chen stood at the place where Xu Ming died, waiting silently.
The death energy was escaping from Xu Ming's body.
The death of a Yin-Yang master is different from that of ordinary people.
The two sources of heaven and earth refined in their bodies will disintegrate after death, turning into the most primitive power of heaven and earth and returning to heaven and earth.
During the process of disintegration, extremely rich death energy will be released.
Those death auras are not resentment or evil spirits, but the pure power of death produced at the moment when the origin of heaven and earth changes from "life" to "death".
Lu Chen's cycle of life and death was running on its own at this moment, like a beast smelling blood, greedily devouring the escaped death energy.
The death energy poured into his body and merged with the true meaning of death on the pill in his spiritual platform.
He could feel the balance of life and death changing within his body.
The true meaning of life is pulled and grown together by the nourishment of death, even in a spiral way.
Life and death are mutually rooted, and yin and yang are mutually reinforcing.
The stronger the death energy, the more vigorous the vitality.
The more vigorous the vitality, the deeper the energy of death!
The bottleneck in the middle stage of Yin-Yang Realm was loosened at this moment.
This vitality bred from death gradually opened up this path of promotion for him.
According to this speed, maybe by killing a few more masters, he can push the Yin and Yang realm to great success, and then gradually even touch the threshold of Dharma!
This thought is like a poisonous vine, climbing up silently from the deepest part of my heart.
Wrapping around his spiritual platform, trying to take root and grow.
Lu Chen suddenly woke up, and a thin layer of cold sweat broke out on his body.
He stabilized his mind, uprooted the thought that had just emerged, and crushed it in his hands.
This idea completely transcended the scope of observing the precepts that he had previously given.
The murderous intention is growing!
Just for the sake of his own strength, he has to let himself go out of control. It is impossible for him to do such a thing.
He took a deep breath, looked away from Xu Ming's body, and looked at the distant mountains shrouded in early winter mist.
Kill the people who deserve to be killed, and take what needs to be taken.
His road should not be simply paved with mountains of corpses and seas of blood!
Lu Chen sank his mind into his dantian and looked at the Wandering God Dao Fruit suspended above the spiritual platform.
The light on the Dao Fruit flickered slightly, like a lighted lamp.
He sensed carefully and found that the progress of the Dao Fruit Ceremony had changed.
Suppress and kill eighteen great demons to complete one of them.
Xu Ming is a human master, but in the judgment of Youshen Daoguo, a human monk at the master level is also considered a "great demon".
This discovery surprised Lu Chen.
He had previously thought that in order to complete the ritual of the Dao Fruit, he had to hunt down the real monsters.
But there are not many monsters in the world, and the spiritual tide has not recovered, so it is even more difficult for monsters to become masters.
He had already made plans to wait until the spiritual tide really came to complete this ritual, and was even prepared to never complete it in this life.
Unexpectedly, there is a bright future!
title_en: Chapter 734: Complaint and Grounding Chapter 733: Fighting Xuan Bing with Yourself
